system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a Helm chart for a stateful application requiring a database migration before pod startup: pre-install hook Job for migrations, StatefulSet for the app, headless Service, and PVC.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Create a Helm chart for a stateful application requiring a database migration before pod startup: pre-install hook Job for migrations, StatefulSet for the app, headless Service, and PVC.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: stateful-app
description: Helm chart for stateful application with DB migration
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: myapp
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  tag: "latest"
migration:
  command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'Running database migrations' && sleep 10"]
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  fsGroup: 1000
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
storage:
  size: 10Gi
  storageClassName: standard
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "stateful-app.name" . }}
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "stateful-app.name" . }}
  ports:
    - port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "stateful-app.name" . }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "stateful-app.name" . }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.storage.storageClassName }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.storage.size }}
---
# FILE: templates/migration-job.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}-migration
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-install
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "-5"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": hook-succeeded
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: migration
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          command: {{- toYaml .Values.migration.command | nindent 12 }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
